page.overview:
Who is Davi?

Davi is a supporting character in the third season of Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

Some point before the event of Jurassic World: Chaos Theory, Davi was a viewer of Brooklynn's videos before the Jurassic World incident.

Before Brooklynn came to investigate the Malta catacombs, Davi was spending most of his time finding clues about the Amber Clave market to take it down. when Brooklynn was sent by the Broker to spend time at the Black market, she noticed that Davi was following her until Brooklynn found him and crossed his arm near the fighting ring where Leonard the Lystrosaurus just killed a Compsognathus. Brooklynn asked who Davi was but Davi was horrified by the Lystrosaurus, until he said that he is in the market to take down Biosyn. after Brooklynn let him go, Davi said that they could work together to take down Biosyn. then Brooklynn said that they should meet in the Malta catacombs in 1 hour but told him not to get caught by Soyona.

Davi meets Brooklynn in the Atrociraptor training spot were Brooklynn was training the Atrociraptors
